name: Menadżer haseł
description: Local encrypted password vault (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM, HKDF-separated verification/encryption keys). Long-lived sidecar process, not spawn-per-request, so the unlocked key survives across actions. Folders, templates, entries, password generator, strength estimate, security audit (weak/reused). v1: fresh vault only (no migration from the legacy Password_menager project), no decoy/duress vault, no online breach checking yet.
